# Troubleshooting

Please [READ THIS FIRST](debug.md)
to learn how to add debugging information to help
troubleshoot Follow the greens.

## It is not a bug, it is a feature

These behaviors are by design.


#### Taxi route generated by X-Dispatch is not taken into account.

1. Taxi route file must be located in

```
<X-Plane 12 Folder> / Output / x-dispatch
```


2. If the file is present, the date/time timestamp that is in the file must be less that 30 minutes old.

```
   "destination": "25L",
   "timestamp": "2026-05-28T07:15:00.000Z",
   "route": { ... },
```

This limitation is by design, to prevent Follow the greens from using an older route from a previous flight.


## Limitation

These behaviors are known to be improvable.
They are no _bugs_, they are limitation imposed by technical or development time reasons.


#### Small, shallow car turns are not smooth

For shallow turns, the car changes orientation progressively with the turn in small step
increment. The car may appear moving in small steps rather than a smooth turn.


#### Little jump of the Follow Me Car at end of startup route/movement

When started/created, the follow me car goes to its starting position
to show the route in front of the aircraft.
If the starting position of the car is in a turn/curve, the car may re-orient
abruptly when joining the route in the turn.
It may also make a little position readjustment of a few meters.
(This is a small technical limitation when a turn terminates into another turn. The junction
of the two turns is not smooth because it needs additional curve smoothing
packages not available in Follow the greens.)


#### Instantaneous car re-orientation at end of taxi route.

At the end of the taxi route, the follow me car may sometimes change direction abruptly
to exit the scene.


## Known Issues

These behaviors are known to be issues that may cause application mis-behavior.
